card.name: Patent grants and patent offices
card.fires_on: Words in explanations of patents and who grants them, such as "by", "office", "government" and "grant" near "patent". Also seen in a few other intellectual-property passages.

modes.label: Patent granting phrases
modes.description: Words in sentences saying a government or office grants a patent.
modes.example: A patent is a grant given<< by>> the Government of Canada.

modes.label: Patent office wording
modes.description: The word office or government after patent or national.
modes.example: The Patent Agent represents the inventor before the Canadian Patent<< Office>> in a similar fashion to how a lawyer

modes.label: Other registration-type text
modes.description: Occasional words in copyright or event-name passages.
modes.example: Andy Murray and Roger Federer are playing each other for the first time in the<< Wimbledon>> Championships final.

card.writes: It pushes toward register and regions words and away from ownership words, a weak link to registration.
card.plain: It lights up in plain explanations of how a patent is granted by a government patent office.
